tablet.notes:
Search conversation: type a word and press search to see its matches highlighted in the conversation, with previous and next at the top.
The filters Images, Videos, Links and Phone numbers slide sideways now.
Since the last update: phone numbers in messages are blue and ask before calling; voice messages and videos download when they arrive.
